documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: GNG Electronics reported its strongest quarterly and first-half performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by broad-based demand, expanding margins, and strong volume growth across domestic and international markets. Management revised its full-year FY27 guidance upwards to 40% revenue growth and a 1.5% improvement in PAT margin compared to the previous year. The company emphasized its brand-building efforts, strategic procurement resulting in elevated inventory, and widening pricing gaps between new and refurbished computers as key levers for sustained profitability. GNG Electronics reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance, highlighting a 42% year-over-year growth in Q2 revenue to Rs. 625 crore and a gross margin expansion to 25%.

guidance.claim: Management revised the full-year FY27 top-line growth guidance to 40% over the previous financial year.
guidance.quote: On the top line for this financial year, we should grow by 40% over previous financial year.

guidance.claim: Management revised the full-year FY27 PAT growth guidance to 1.5% from the previous guidance of 1%.
guidance.quote: And on the bottom line PAT point of view, it should be growing by 1.5% from previous guidance of 1%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the full-year tax rate is estimated to be between 14% to 16%.
guidance.quote: From a guidance perspective for the full year, it will be fair to assume in your stack that the tax rate should be relative to 10.6%, 11% last year, it will be fair to assume a number somewhere between 14% to 16% from an assessment perspective.

guidance.claim: Management revised the full year FY27 revenue guidance upward from 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: In terms of specific guidance, we would like to revise our revenue guidance from earlier 25% to 30% and at the PAT level margin growth, we would like to increase it from 0.5% to 0.75% -1%.

demand_outlook.claim: The global ICT industry is witnessing a structural shift towards professionally refurbished computing solutions driven by rising prices of new devices and supply-side constraints.
demand_outlook.quote: The global ICT industry continues to witness a structural shift towards professionally refurbished computing solutions, driven by rising prices of new devices, supply-side constraints in the global memory market, increasing focus on cost optimisation and sustainability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains confident in the long-term growth opportunity for the refurbished ICT industry driven by affordability, reliability, and sustainability.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident in the long-term growth opportunity for the refurbished ICT industry. While rising memory prices and supply constraints provide a near-term catalyst, the underlying opportunity is driven by a structural shift towards affordability, reliability and sustainability.

demand_outlook.claim: IDC projected global PC shipments to decline by 11.3% for the full year 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: As previously highlighted, IDC now projects global PC shipments to decline 11.3% for full year 2026 with conditions expected to worsen in the second half, driving a 20% year-on-year decline in that period alone.

demand_outlook.claim: The price of an entry-level 8GB RAM and 512GB SSD laptop rose from INR40,000 to INR48,000.
demand_outlook.quote: Price of an entry-level 8GB RAM and 512GB SSD laptop has further risen from INR40,000 to INR48,000.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened its first exclusive Electronics Bazaar store for small and medium businesses in Jaipur in partnership with Techjack.
capex_expansion.quote: We also opened our first exclusive Electronics Bazaar stores for small and medium businesses in Jaipur in partnership with our channel partner, Techjack.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue stood at INR624.8 crores for the quarter ended September 2026, up from INR439.9 crores in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter ended September 2026, our consolidated revenue stood at INR624.8 crores, which is up from INR439.9 crores in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin improved by 515 basis points year-on-year to 25.1% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin improved by 515 basis points year-on-year to 25.1%.

margins_costs.claim: For the first half of FY27, revenue stood at INR1,037 crores with gross margin expansion at 24.9%, an improvement of 438 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: Similarly, for the first half of FY27, revenue stood at INR1,037 crores, which is 38% up from the same period last year with gross margin expansion at 24.9%, which is an improvement of 438 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Advanced inventory strategic decisions contributed between 125 to 150 basis points to the margin enhancement in the concluded quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Of this, it will be fair to assume that somewhere between 125 to 150 basis points is on account of the advanced inventory strategic decisions that have been taken.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 gross margin expanded by 515 bps YoY to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: Against this backdrop, we delivered a strong performance in Q2 FY27, with revenue growing 42% YoY to ₹625 crore, while gross margin expanded by 515 bps YoY to 25%.

margins_costs.claim: For H1 FY27, gross margin improved by 438 bps to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: For H1 FY27, revenue grew 38% YoY to ₹1,037 crore, with gross margin improving by 438 bps to 25%, reflecting the strength of our business model and continued execution momentum.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margins stood at 15.0% compared to 10.6% in Q2 FY26.
Gross margin expanded to 24.65%, which is an improvement of 329 basis points year-on-year and 542 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded to 24.65%, improving by 329 basis points over last year and 542 basis points over the previous quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Memory prices rose by a further 5% to 10% in the last quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Memory prices have risen a further 5% to 10% in the last quarter alone.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin stood at 12.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR52.8 crores, with EBITDA margin at 12.8%, an improvement of 156 basis points year-on-year compared to 11.3% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin expanded to 7% compared to 5.9% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin expanded to 7%, compared to 5.9% in Q1 FY26, an improvement of 108 basis points year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q2, the company processed a total volume of about 2,25,000 units, and for the first half, the volume was about 3,74,000 units.
orders_capacity.quote: So in the quarter 2, we have had a total volume of about 2,25,000-odd units. And for the first half, the number is about 3,74,000-odd units.

orders_capacity.claim: The proportion between laptops and other products remains in the trajectory of 78% to 80% being laptops and the rest being other products.
orders_capacity.quote: Broadly, this proportion between laptops and others continues to remain in the same trajectory of between 78% to 80% being laptops and others being the rest of it in terms of revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Customer touch points stand at 5,542, up from 5,130, and the supply base stands at 820, up from 773.
orders_capacity.quote: Customer touch points stand at 5,542, up from 5,130 and our supply base at 820, up from 773.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expanded its reach to 55 countries, increased customer touchpoints to 5,542, and grew its supplier base to 820.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we continued to strengthen our domestic and international presence, expanding our reach to 55 countries, increasing customer touchpoints to 5,542 and growing our supplier base to 820.

orders_capacity.claim: Electronics Bazaar supplies to 49 countries as of the end of Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: As of end of Q1 FY27, Electronics Bazaar supplies to 49 countries, up from 46 at the end of FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Customer touchpoints grew to 5,130 at the end of Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Customer touchpoints have grown to 5,130 and our supplier base now stands at 773, reflecting deeper and more diversified sourcing across geographies.

capital_allocation.claim: The current net debt is about INR427 crores, and management anticipates a similar debt level for the full year.
capital_allocation.quote: As you would have seen the numbers, the current net debt is about INR427-odd crores. We anticipate that this level of debt, which was about INR406 crores at the end of previous quarter, right? So the current level of debt is something which we anticipate is a fair number to assume going forward as well. At the same point of time, factoring in the opportunity and the elevated inventory associated costs. But that said, it will be fair to assume a similar debt level for the full year as well.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt increased by about INR100-odd crores to INR406 crores at the end of Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: This number was about INR399 crores or almost rounding off to INR400 crores at the end of March '26. This has gone to INR406 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: IDC projects a decline of 11.3% for the full year 2026 in global PC shipments on a base of 284 million computers sold in 2025.
risks_headwinds.quote: For the full year 2026, IDC continues to project a decline of 11.3%, which is on a base of 284 million computers sold in 2025 that's roughly 30 million decline of computers sold over last year and we are not factoring in any growth in computing demand.

risks_headwinds.claim: No meaningful relief for persistent memory shortages is expected before the end of 2027.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary driver remains the persistent memory shortage for which no meaningful relief is expected before end of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will grow top-line by 40% over the previous financial year.
management_commitments.quote: On the top line for this financial year, we should grow by 40% over previous financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the bottom line PAT will grow by 1.5% from the previous guidance of 1%.
management_commitments.quote: And on the bottom line PAT point of view, it should be growing by 1.5% from previous guidance of 1%.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that two years down the line, the inventory level should reach around 90 days of projected sale.
management_commitments.quote: That's a very, very right expectation when situation reaches a new normal, at that point in time, we should have around 90 days of inventory.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the company remains focused on continuing to deliver profitable, sustainable growth for the full year.
management_commitments.quote: We are comfortably ahead of our full year FY27 guidance, and we remain focused on continuing to deliver profitable, sustainable growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
